# Upgrade guides

Generated when `@deepseek-ai/dsh` is packed. A `v<T>` section lists what to change when upgrading from release vT to the release after it; vT is the release being left, not the target. Paths are relative to this file.

打包 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 时生成。`v<T>` 一节列出从 vT 版本升级到其下一个版本时需要做的修改；vT 是升级前的版本，不是目标版本。路径相对于本文件。

## v0.2.2-rc.1

| Item | Summary | 摘要 | English | 中文 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Update account notification consumers | Generic account notification APIs replace bonus-specific methods and notification requests use the Harness domain. | 通用账号通知 API 替换赠金专用方法，通知请求改用 Harness 域名。 | [v0.2.2-rc.1/account-notification-fields/guide.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/account-notification-fields/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-rc.1/account-notification-fields/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/account-notification-fields/guide.zh.md) |
| Account service and Remote imports | Move account plugin composition and Remote imports to the concrete deepseek-account service. | 将账号插件组合与 Remote 导入迁移到具体的 deepseek-account 服务。 | [v0.2.2-rc.1/account-remote-provider/guide.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/account-remote-provider/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-rc.1/account-remote-provider/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/account-remote-provider/guide.zh.md) |
| Worktree cleanup on archive | Archiving a Session can remove its clean worktree while retaining the branch, and the Forge bundle mounts one worktree service. | 归档 Session 可以删除其干净的工作树并保留分支，Forge bundle 只挂载一个工作树服务。 | [v0.2.2-rc.1/archive-worktrees/guide.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/archive-worktrees/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-rc.1/archive-worktrees/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/archive-worktrees/guide.zh.md) |
| Attachment failures keep their codes | AttachmentError now extends HarnessError, so tool and model-request failures record attachment codes instead of losing them or reporting UNKNOWN. | AttachmentError 现在继承 HarnessError，工具失败与模型请求失败会记录附件错误码，不再丢失或报告为 UNKNOWN。 | [v0.2.2-rc.1/attachment-error-codes/guide.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/attachment-error-codes/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-rc.1/attachment-error-codes/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/attachment-error-codes/guide.zh.md) |
| macOS AX tree read limits | macOS reads more AX nodes by default and accepts per-read overrides of configured traversal budgets. | macOS 默认读取更多 AX 节点，调用方可为单次读取覆盖配置值。 | [v0.2.2-rc.1/cua-ax-read-limits/guide.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/cua-ax-read-limits/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-rc.1/cua-ax-read-limits/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/cua-ax-read-limits/guide.zh.md) |
| macOS hover keeps the system pointer in place by default | macOS mouseMove requires AX alternate UI by default and returns HOVER_UNAVAILABLE instead of moving the user's cursor. | macOS 的 mouseMove 默认要求控件支持 AX 备用界面，否则返回 HOVER_UNAVAILABLE，保留用户的光标位置。 | [v0.2.2-rc.1/cua-hover-ax-only/guide.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/cua-hover-ax-only/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-rc.1/cua-hover-ax-only/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/cua-hover-ax-only/guide.zh.md) |
| Native CUA application and window API | Migrate CUA scripts and custom native providers to scoped window input, string element IDs, and platform capabilities. | 迁移 CUA 脚本和自定义原生提供方，使用显式窗口、字符串元素 ID 和平台能力声明。 | [v0.2.2-rc.1/cua-native-platform/guide.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/cua-native-platform/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-rc.1/cua-native-platform/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/cua-native-platform/guide.zh.md) |
| `dsh-doc` replaces the Creator mode skills | Creator mode replaces its four skills with one `dsh-doc` skill, and the repository documentation skill becomes `dsh-doc-writing`. | 创造模式用一个 `dsh-doc` skill 取代原有的四个 skill，仓库文档 skill 更名为 `dsh-doc-writing`。 | [v0.2.2-rc.1/dsh-doc-skill/guide.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/dsh-doc-skill/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-rc.1/dsh-doc-skill/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/dsh-doc-skill/guide.zh.md) |
| Forge snapshots carry the change request overview, and actions report unknown outcomes | ChangeRequestSnapshot gains required overview fields, ChangeRequestCheck gains the required rerun field, and ForgeActionFailure gains the unknown code. | ChangeRequestSnapshot 新增必填的概览字段，ChangeRequestCheck 新增必填的 rerun 字段，ForgeActionFailure 新增 unknown 代码。 | [v0.2.2-rc.1/forge-change-request-overview/guide.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/forge-change-request-overview/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-rc.1/forge-change-request-overview/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/forge-change-request-overview/guide.zh.md) |
| Forge diffs read one head commit | ForgeProvider.diff and ctx.forge.diff take the head commit to read, ForgeFailure gains the stale code, and ChangeRequestSnapshot gains threadsTruncated. | ForgeProvider.diff 与 ctx.forge.diff 需要传入要读取的 head 提交，ForgeFailure 新增 stale 代码，ChangeRequestSnapshot 新增 threadsTruncated。 | [v0.2.2-rc.1/forge-pinned-diff/guide.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/forge-pinned-diff/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-rc.1/forge-pinned-diff/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/forge-pinned-diff/guide.zh.md) |
| Forge failures report unsupported reads | ForgeFailure gains the unsupported code, which ctx.forge.readReview returns for a provider without review reads. | ForgeFailure 新增 unsupported 代码；提供方不支持读取评审讨论时，ctx.forge.readReview 返回它。 | [v0.2.2-rc.1/forge-review-reads/guide.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/forge-review-reads/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-rc.1/forge-review-reads/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/forge-review-reads/guide.zh.md) |
| `BundleInfo.update` replaces `BundleInfo.updatable` | BundleInfo.updatable is replaced by BundleInfo.update, and ManagementError gains the unexpected-package code. | BundleInfo.updatable 由 BundleInfo.update 取代，ManagementError 新增 unexpected-package 错误码。 | [v0.2.2-rc.1/plugin-update-method/guide.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/plugin-update-method/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-rc.1/plugin-update-method/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/plugin-update-method/guide.zh.md) |
| Runtime-context reminder records | Runtime-context log text gains reminder framing, and clear markers record empty snapshot sections. | 运行时上下文日志文本增加提醒包装，清空标记记录空的快照条目。 | [v0.2.2-rc.1/runtime-context-reminders/guide.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/runtime-context-reminders/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-rc.1/runtime-context-reminders/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/runtime-context-reminders/guide.zh.md) |
| Update replacements for `Session.append` | Code that replaces Session.append must implement both the single-event and array overloads. | 替换 Session.append 的代码必须实现单事件和数组两种重载。 | [v0.2.2-rc.1/session-append-overloads/guide.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/session-append-overloads/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-rc.1/session-append-overloads/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/session-append-overloads/guide.zh.md) |
| Built-in configurations disable agent interruption | Built-in configurations disable interrupt_agent for subagents and Team mode. | 内置配置关闭普通 subagent 和 Team 模式的 interrupt_agent。 | [v0.2.2-rc.1/subagent-interrupt-default/guide.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/subagent-interrupt-default/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-rc.1/subagent-interrupt-default/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/subagent-interrupt-default/guide.zh.md) |
| `TerminalBackendCleanupError` extends `TerminalError` | TerminalBackendCleanupError extends TerminalError instead of AggregateError and carries the CLEANUP_FAILED code. | TerminalBackendCleanupError 改为继承 TerminalError 而非 AggregateError，并带 CLEANUP_FAILED 错误码。 | [v0.2.2-rc.1/terminal-backend-cleanup-error/guide.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/terminal-backend-cleanup-error/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-rc.1/terminal-backend-cleanup-error/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/terminal-backend-cleanup-error/guide.zh.md) |
| Persistent terminals open in the Web sidebar | The experimental terminal bundle opens Agent terminals in the Web sidebar and replaces its optional-terminal-bash and optional-terminal-pwsh rows with optional-terminal-panel. | 实验终端 bundle 改为在 Web 侧栏打开 Agent 终端，并用 optional-terminal-panel 行替换 optional-terminal-bash 和 optional-terminal-pwsh 行。 | [v0.2.2-rc.1/terminal-bundle-sidebar-backend/guide.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/terminal-bundle-sidebar-backend/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-rc.1/terminal-bundle-sidebar-backend/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/terminal-bundle-sidebar-backend/guide.zh.md) |
| DeepSeek web search and fetch choose their credential by billing | DeepSeek Search and Fetch add per-capability billing and replace provider authentication fields with ordered credential sources. | DeepSeek Search 与 Fetch 新增按能力选择的计费方式，并将提供方认证字段替换为有序凭据来源。 | [v0.2.2-rc.1/web-search-billing/guide.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/web-search-billing/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-rc.1/web-search-billing/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/web-search-billing/guide.zh.md) |
| Explicit window regions for custom Client overlays | Custom Client overlays that relied on global macOS no-drag exclusions must declare their window regions. | 依赖 macOS 全局 no-drag 排除的自定义 Client 浮层必须声明自己的窗口区域。 | [v0.2.2-rc.1/window-drag-regions/guide.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/window-drag-regions/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-rc.1/window-drag-regions/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-rc.1/window-drag-regions/guide.zh.md) |

## v0.2.2-alpha.3

| Item | Summary | 摘要 | English | 中文 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Chat `ProcessActivity` adds `context` | Chat ProcessActivity gains a context category, and the running activity uses RunningProcessActivity. | Chat 的 ProcessActivity 新增 context 类别，运行中活动改用 RunningProcessActivity。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.3/chat-process-activity-context/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.3/chat-process-activity-context/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.3/chat-process-activity-context/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.3/chat-process-activity-context/guide.zh.md) |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-office-kit` replaces `@deepseek-ai/dsh-office-to-pdf` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-office-kit` replaces `@deepseek-ai/dsh-office-to-pdf`, renaming its service, Remote methods, exported types, and configuration row. | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-office-kit` 取代 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-office-to-pdf`，其服务、Remote 方法、导出类型和配置行随之改名。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.3/office-kit-package/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.3/office-kit-package/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.3/office-kit-package/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.3/office-kit-package/guide.zh.md) |
| Office operation skills are replaced by Office tools | The `office-render`, `office-recalculate`, and `office-export-pdf` skills, the skill-office `node` and `cli` keys, and two Office CLI environment variables are removed; Office operations use skill-activated tools. | 删除 `office-render`、`office-recalculate` 和 `office-export-pdf` 技能、skill-office 的 `node` 和 `cli` 配置键，以及两个 Office CLI 环境变量；Office 操作改用由技能激活的工具。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.3/office-operation-tools/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.3/office-operation-tools/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.3/office-operation-tools/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.3/office-operation-tools/guide.zh.md) |
| Office skills load from the packaged assets | `DSH_BUNDLED_OFFICE_SKILLS` and the `office-skills/` resource directories are removed; Office skills load from the `skill-office` package's assets. | `DSH_BUNDLED_OFFICE_SKILLS` 和 `office-skills/` 资源目录被删除；Office 技能从 `skill-office` 包的 assets 加载。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.3/office-skill-resources/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.3/office-skill-resources/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.3/office-skill-resources/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.3/office-skill-resources/guide.zh.md) |
| Subagent tools address agents by name | Subagent control and Team task tools address agents by name, list_agents rows change, and subagent catalogs write payload version 3. | Subagent 控制工具和 Team 任务工具按名称寻址 agent，list_agents 行格式改变，subagent 目录写入第 3 版载荷。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.3/subagent-names/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.3/subagent-names/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.3/subagent-names/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.3/subagent-names/guide.zh.md) |

## v0.2.2-alpha.2

| Item | Summary | 摘要 | English | 中文 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Context menu types and icons | Client plugins must use the prefixed context menu types and hooks and register keyed icon components. | Client 插件须使用带前缀的右键菜单类型和 hook，并注册 keyed 图标组件。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/context-menu-target/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/context-menu-target/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/context-menu-target/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/context-menu-target/guide.zh.md) |
| Loader entry tree reports and Include persistence | Loader entry trees report mutations through commit(change), and Include persists them through a journal. | Loader 条目树通过 commit(change) 报告变更，Include 通过 journal 持久化这些变更。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/cordis-loader-entry-trees/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/cordis-loader-entry-trees/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/cordis-loader-entry-trees/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/cordis-loader-entry-trees/guide.zh.md) |
| CSS-anchored menus | Client UI consumers must replace JavaScript panel positioning and Menu rectangle callbacks with CSS anchors. | Client UI 使用方必须将 JavaScript 面板定位和 Menu 矩形回调替换为 CSS 锚点。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/css-anchored-menus/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/css-anchored-menus/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/css-anchored-menus/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/css-anchored-menus/guide.zh.md) |
| Source-built Computer Use helper identity | Source-built Computer Use helpers use a separate development bundle identifier and need one new macOS permission grant. | 源码构建的 Computer Use helper 使用独立的开发版 Bundle ID，需要重新授予一次 macOS 权限。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/cua-source-dev-helper/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/cua-source-dev-helper/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/cua-source-dev-helper/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/cua-source-dev-helper/guide.zh.md) |
| Desktop stable channel name | The Desktop stable update channel is named stable instead of latest. | 桌面正式更新渠道由 latest 更名为 stable。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/desktop-stable-channel/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/desktop-stable-channel/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/desktop-stable-channel/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/desktop-stable-channel/guide.zh.md) |
| Forge Git query permissions and content conversion | Forge Git queries use Session permissions and disable configured diff helpers. | Forge Git 查询使用 Session 权限并禁用已配置的 diff 辅助程序。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/forge-git-permissions/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/forge-git-permissions/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/forge-git-permissions/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/forge-git-permissions/guide.zh.md) |
| One plugin entry for change requests and worktrees | The Plugins page replaces the standalone Git worktrees card with Change requests & worktrees. | 插件页将独立的 Git 工作树卡片合入变更请求与工作树。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/forge-worktree-entry/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/forge-worktree-entry/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/forge-worktree-entry/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/forge-worktree-entry/guide.zh.md) |
| Filesystem mutations no longer require a prior read by default | The fs-observation-policy row ships disabled, so write, edit, and apply_patch no longer require a prior read, and dsh-base plus the Web standard preset gain apply_patch. | fs-observation-policy 行随发行版禁用，write、edit 与 apply_patch 不再要求先读，dsh-base 与 Web standard preset 新增 apply_patch。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/fs-observation-policy-default-off/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/fs-observation-policy-default-off/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/fs-observation-policy-default-off/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/fs-observation-policy-default-off/guide.zh.md) |
| `new LlmError` accepts only built-in failure codes | `new LlmError` accepts only built-in failure codes; other codes go through `LlmError.fromFailure`. | `new LlmError` 只接受内置失败 code；其他 code 改用 `LlmError.fromFailure`。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/llm-error-builtin-codes/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/llm-error-builtin-codes/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/llm-error-builtin-codes/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/llm-error-builtin-codes/guide.zh.md) |
| Declare auxiliary LLM request purposes | Auxiliary LLM request purposes require producer-owned type declarations instead of a shared fixed union. | 辅助 LLM 请求用途改为生产方拥有的类型声明，不再使用共享固定联合。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/llm-request-purpose-declarations/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/llm-request-purpose-declarations/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/llm-request-purpose-declarations/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/llm-request-purpose-declarations/guide.zh.md) |
| pi-ai request image count | pi-ai routes now offload the oldest history images once a request carries more than 50 retained images. | 当请求保留的图片超过 50 张时，pi-ai 路由现在会省略历史中最老的图片。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/pi-ai-request-image-count/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/pi-ai-request-image-count/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/pi-ai-request-image-count/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/pi-ai-request-image-count/guide.zh.md) |
| Projection frames list every key one event changed | Live Session projection frames list every key one committed event changed instead of carrying one key each. | 实时 Session projection 帧改为列出一个已提交事件改变的全部 key，不再每帧只带一个 key。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/projection-event-frames/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/projection-event-frames/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/projection-event-frames/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/projection-event-frames/guide.zh.md) |
| Released projection units stay in checkpoints | `ctx.sessionProjections.checkpoint(session)` keeps a released unit's last row instead of omitting it. | `ctx.sessionProjections.checkpoint(session)` 保留已释放单元的最后一行，而不再省略它。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/projection-released-checkpoint/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/projection-released-checkpoint/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/projection-released-checkpoint/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/projection-released-checkpoint/guide.zh.md) |
| Projection snapshot scope | Projection snapshot reads compute only the returned units, the registry cached snapshot read is deprecated, and Session list summaries omit context pressure and breakdown. | 投影 snapshot 读取只计算返回的单元，注册表的 cached snapshot 读取已废弃，Session 列表摘要不再包含 context pressure 和 breakdown。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/projection-snapshot-scope/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/projection-snapshot-scope/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/projection-snapshot-scope/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/projection-snapshot-scope/guide.zh.md) |
| Retained PTC timeout recovery | Retained Node PTC uses cooperative stop on timeout or cancellation, with process termination when acknowledgment fails. | 保留状态的 Node PTC 在超时或取消时协作式停止，确认失败时终止进程兜底。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/retained-ptc-timeout/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/retained-ptc-timeout/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/retained-ptc-timeout/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/retained-ptc-timeout/guide.zh.md) |
| Schedule tools manage every Host task by RRULE and target | The Schedule model tools become `schedule_create`, `schedule_list`, `schedule_view`, and `schedule_edit` over every Host task, and `schedule_update` and `schedule_delete` are removed. | Schedule 的模型工具改为面向宿主全部任务的 `schedule_create`、`schedule_list`、`schedule_view` 与 `schedule_edit`，并移除 `schedule_update` 与 `schedule_delete`。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/schedule-agent-tools/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/schedule-agent-tools/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/schedule-agent-tools/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/schedule-agent-tools/guide.zh.md) |
| Schedule uses one Host-wide management API | Schedule clients use one Host-wide management API and typed timing records; stored Host tasks keep the existing domain and layout. | Schedule 客户端改用统一的宿主管理 API 和带类型时间记录；已有宿主任务保留现有领域和布局。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/schedule-remote-host-tasks/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/schedule-remote-host-tasks/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/schedule-remote-host-tasks/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/schedule-remote-host-tasks/guide.zh.md) |
| SDK run accepts native commands | SDK run recognizes native commands and returns RunResult after its input completes. | SDK run 识别原生命令，并在本次输入完成后返回 RunResult。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/sdk-run-commands/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/sdk-run-commands/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/sdk-run-commands/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/sdk-run-commands/guide.zh.md) |
| Session Header menus and export dialogs | Custom Web compositions must provide context menus for Session actions, and export dialogs now remain visible across Session switches. | 自定义 Web 组合必须为会话操作提供右键菜单服务，导出弹窗在切换 Session 后仍保持显示。 | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/session-header-menu/guide.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/session-header-menu/guide.md) | [v0.2.2-alpha.2/session-header-menu/guide.zh.md](v0.2.2-alpha.2/session-header-menu/guide.zh.md) |

| Terminal command labels | Custom TerminalBlock consumers must provide localized accessible names for overflowing command lines. | 自定义 TerminalBlock 消费者必须为横向溢出的命令行提供本地化的无障碍名称。 | [v0.2.1-alpha.1/terminal-command-labels/guide.md](v0.2.1-alpha.1/terminal-command-labels/guide.md) | [v0.2.1-alpha.1/terminal-command-labels/guide.zh.md](v0.2.1-alpha.1/terminal-command-labels/guide.zh.md) |
| Select native or PTC tool presentation | Tool presentation accepts native or ptc; the mixed both mode is rejected. | 工具呈现方式仅接受 native 或 ptc；混合的 both 模式会被拒绝。 | [v0.2.1-alpha.1/tool-presentation-mode/guide.md](v0.2.1-alpha.1/tool-presentation-mode/guide.md) | [v0.2.1-alpha.1/tool-presentation-mode/guide.zh.md](v0.2.1-alpha.1/tool-presentation-mode/guide.zh.md) |
| Web listener and trust configuration moves to `webStartup` | The Web profile replaces the `webRuntime` service and the `web-runtime` row's `trustedHosts` config with `webStartup`, and rejects a wildcard listener host. | Web profile 用 `webStartup` 取代 `webRuntime` 服务与 `web-runtime` 行的 `trustedHosts` 配置，并拒绝通配监听地址。 | [v0.2.1-alpha.1/web-listener-trust-config/guide.md](v0.2.1-alpha.1/web-listener-trust-config/guide.md) | [v0.2.1-alpha.1/web-listener-trust-config/guide.zh.md](v0.2.1-alpha.1/web-listener-trust-config/guide.zh.md) |
